description.html: The artificial plant with long branches is a light green plant whose leafy branches spread sideways. It stands on a dark rock-shaped base that blends into natural decor.

The advantage of an artificial plant is that it looks the same day after day: it does not rot, lose leaves or need strong lighting or fertilizer. It does not affect water parameters, and fish use it as cover, especially younger and shyer ones.

Since it spreads more in width than in height, it fills the front and middle of the aquarium and gaps between stones and roots well. Bottom-dwelling fish like to hide under the branches. When algae appear on the leaves, take the plant out, rinse it under lukewarm water and brush it with a soft brush. Do not use chemical cleaners, as residues can end up in the water.
